loneliness.name: Loneliness
loneliness.line: Most days I don't talk to anyone who really knows me.
loneliness.why: Keeps the plain name and says what being alone looks like in a day, which also sets it apart from having no one to call or no one to go out with.

loneliness.name: Company
loneliness.line: I go whole days without a real conversation with anyone.
loneliness.why: An area-style name like the rest of the People heading, with a line someone could picture and recognize as their own week.

no-one-to-lean-on.name: Someone to call
no-one-to-lean-on.line: I have no one to call when I need help.
no-one-to-lean-on.why: "Support" is the name of It's own Support It flow, so a different name avoids confusion; the line already says it well.

no-one-to-lean-on.name: No backup
no-one-to-lean-on.line: When something goes wrong, there's no one I can lean on.
no-one-to-lean-on.why: Uses the ID's own words for the line and makes the moment of need concrete, with a short name that isn't It's Support flow.

new-here.name: New in town
new-here.line: I just moved here and don't know anyone yet.
new-here.why: Says the situation rather than the act of moving, which could also mean the stress of packing or paying for a move.

nobody-to-do-things-with.name: Plans
nobody-to-do-things-with.line: I'd go out more if I had someone to go with.
nobody-to-do-things-with.why: Keeps the original wish to go out, and says the missing piece is a companion rather than an invitation, which matches the ID.

drifted-apart.name: Old friends
drifted-apart.line: I've drifted apart from friends who used to matter a lot to me.
drifted-apart.why: "Friends" alone could sit over several pains on this heading; "old friends" and "drifted apart" name this one.

lost-faith-community.name: Faith community
lost-faith-community.line: I left my faith community and lost my people with it.
lost-faith-community.why: The ID names a faith community, and the current name "Belonging" is the same as another pain's name on this heading.

lost-faith-community.name: Lost community
lost-faith-community.line: I've lost the community I used to be part of.
lost-faith-community.why: Keeps the broader meaning (church, team, scene, hometown) but gives it a name that doesn't repeat the Belonging pain.
